meta.note: Problem-level evidence has not been coded yet. Candidate methods are design hypotheses, not measured effects. P0 records under adjudication are excluded from evidence lists.

problems.desc_en: Treatment and outcome are observed without randomization. Measured or unmeasured confounding can bias the estimate.
problems.desc_zh: 处理变量和结局来自观测数据，缺少随机化。已测或未测混杂都会影响估计。

problems.desc_en: The test distribution differs from training. The question is which relations stay stable and which mechanisms change.
problems.desc_zh: 测试分布与训练分布不同。需要判断哪些关系保持稳定，哪些机制发生变化。

problems.desc_en: The decision needs an estimate of what would happen under an alternative action, prompt, model, or policy.
problems.desc_zh: 决策需要估计另一个动作、提示、模型或策略下会发生什么。

problems.desc_en: An agent can act, query, or intervene. The task is to decide what to try and how to update its model.
problems.desc_zh: Agent 可以行动、查询或干预。任务是决定试什么，以及如何更新模型。

problems.desc_en: The graph is unknown. The task is to recover edges, orientations, or an equivalence class from data and constraints.
problems.desc_zh: 因果图未知。任务是从数据和约束中恢复边、方向或等价类。

problems.desc_en: Observations are ordered in time. The task involves lagged effects, nonstationarity, and changing mechanisms.
problems.desc_zh: 观测按时间排列。任务涉及滞后效应、非平稳性和机制变化。

problems.desc_en: The model reads text or dialogue and must answer causal questions, use background knowledge, or audit a causal claim.
problems.desc_zh: 模型读取文本或对话，回答因果问题、使用背景知识，或核查一条因果主张。

F5.name: Independent mechanisms
F5.assumptions_en: Independent causal mechanisms; invariance across environments
F5.assumptions_zh: 机制在环境间保持独立且稳定；有足够的环境或干预来估计不变性。
F5.failure_en: Mechanisms not independent; environments unavailable; IRM negative results
F5.failure_zh: 机制发生变化或环境标签错误时，不变性约束会失效。

I1.name: Backdoor adjustment
I1.assumptions_en: No unmeasured confounders; positivity; correct graph
I1.assumptions_zh: 不存在未测混杂；正值性成立；调整集来自正确因果图。
I1.failure_en: Unmeasured confounding; bad adjustment sets; positivity violations
I1.failure_zh: 调整集错误、未测混杂或重叠不足时，后门估计有偏。

I6.name: Consistency & SUTVA
I6.assumptions_en: Consistency; no interference; well-defined treatment versions
I6.assumptions_zh: 处理版本一致；个体之间无干扰，或干扰可建模。
I6.failure_zh: 提示版本不同或 Agent 之间互相影响时，处理定义失效。

I12.name: Transportability
I12.assumptions_zh: 有选择图；源域和目标域的机制可迁移。
I12.failure_en: Selection diagram misspecification; no target data
I12.failure_zh: 选择图错误或目标域缺少支持时，迁移公式失效。

I13.name: Mediation / direct-indirect effects
I13.assumptions_zh: 无中介与结局的混杂；跨世界假设成立。
I13.failure_zh: 中介与结局存在混杂或跨世界假设不成立时，效应分解失效。

I17.name: Sensitivity analysis
I17.assumptions_zh: 敏感性模型可解释；未测混杂的范围可以设定。
I17.failure_zh: 敏感性参数难以解释或范围过宽时，结论仍然脆弱。

E1.name: Matching / propensity scores
E1.assumptions_zh: 无未测混杂；正值性；倾向模型正确。
E1.failure_zh: 倾向模型错误或重叠不足时，匹配样本有偏。

E5.name: Doubly robust / AIPW / TMLE
E5.assumptions_en: One of treatment/outcome models correct; positivity
E5.assumptions_zh: 处理模型或结局模型之一正确；正值性成立。
E5.failure_zh: nuisance 模型误差或有限样本不稳定时，双重稳健性下降。

E6.assumptions_zh: Neyman 正交；交叉拟合；重叠足够。
E6.failure_en: Weak overlap; many nuisances; small N
E6.failure_zh: 重叠不足、nuisance 维度过高或样本小时，估计不稳定。

E7.name: Heterogeneous effects
E7.assumptions_en: Unconfoundedness; overlap; enough data per stratum
E7.assumptions_zh: 无未测混杂；重叠足够；每个子组有足够样本。
E7.failure_zh: CATE 不稳定或子组样本稀疏时，异质效应难以复核。

D1.assumptions_en: Markov; faithfulness; causal sufficiency (PC) or latent confounders (FCI)
D1.assumptions_zh: 马尔可夫与忠实性；PC 需要因果充分性，FCI 允许潜混杂。
D1.failure_zh: CI 检验错误、忠实性违背或样本不足时，图结构错误。

D2.name: Score-based discovery (GES/NOTEARS)
D2.assumptions_zh: 分数等价；无环约束；样本量足够。
D2.failure_zh: 局部最优、规模化困难或无环惩罚敏感时，结构不稳定。

D4.assumptions_zh: 目标可干预；忠实性；干预预算有限。
D4.failure_zh: 干预昂贵或目标有限时，主动发现无法覆盖关键边。

D5.assumptions_zh: 平稳性或可建模的非平稳；因果充分性；滞后阶正确。

D6.failure_zh: 可识别性假设强、评测困难或规模扩大时，表示不稳定。

candidates.why: Adjust for measured confounders with an explicit graph and adjustment set.
candidates.minimal_test: Hold out a negative-control outcome and check whether the adjusted estimate stays stable.
candidates.why_zh: 用显式因果图和调整集控制已测混杂。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 留出一个负对照结局，检查调整后的估计是否稳定。

candidates.why: Match or weight treated and control units on observed covariates.
candidates.minimal_test: Check covariate balance before and after matching on a held-out split.
candidates.why_zh: 在已测协变量上对处理组和对照组做匹配或加权。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在留出集上检查匹配前后的协变量平衡。

candidates.why: Combine an outcome model and a treatment model so that either one can be wrong.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare AIPW or TMLE with IPW and g-computation on a held-out split.
candidates.why_zh: 同时建模结局和处理，允许其中一个模型设定错误。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在留出集上比较 AIPW 或 TMLE 与 IPW、g-computation。

candidates.why: Use orthogonal moments and cross-fitting when nuisance models are high-dimensional.
candidates.minimal_test: Add a placebo treatment and verify that the estimated effect collapses.
candidates.why_zh: nuisance 模型维度高时，使用正交矩和交叉拟合。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 加入一个安慰剂处理，检查估计效应是否消失。

candidates.why: Quantify how strong an unmeasured confounder would need to be to change the conclusion.
candidates.minimal_test: Report an E-value or Rosenbaum bound alongside the point estimate.
candidates.why_zh: 估计未测混杂需要多强才会改变结论。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在点估计旁报告 E 值或 Rosenbaum 边界。

candidates.why: Backdoor adjustment is available when the unmeasured part can be bounded or proxied.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare the adjusted estimate with and without the proxy variable.
candidates.why_zh: 未测部分可以被界定或代理时，后门调整仍然可用。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 比较加入代理变量前后的调整估计。

candidates.why: Model stable mechanisms across environments and penalize relations that vary.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare ERM and an invariance penalty on leave-one-domain-out splits.
candidates.why_zh: 建模跨环境稳定的机制，对随环境变化的关系施加惩罚。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在留一域划分上比较 ERM 与不变性惩罚。

candidates.why: State the source and target populations with a selection diagram before transferring.
candidates.minimal_test: Run leave-one-site-out and check whether the transport formula beats pooled training.
candidates.why_zh: 迁移前用选择图说明源人群和目标人群。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 做留一站点检验，比较迁移公式与合并训练。

candidates.why: Learn a representation whose stable factors are separable from domain-specific ones.
candidates.minimal_test: Recover known latent factors on a synthetic SCM with a held-out domain.
candidates.why_zh: 学习一种表示，使稳定因子可以与领域特有因子分开。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在带留出域的合成 SCM 上恢复已知潜因子。

candidates.why: Estimate whether the effect differs across groups or domains instead of reporting one pooled number.
candidates.minimal_test: Check CATE stability across held-out domains and report subgroup overlap.
candidates.why_zh: 估计效应在群体或领域间是否有差异，而不是只报告一个合并数字。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 检查 CATE 在留出域上的稳定性，并报告子组重叠。

candidates.why: Separate direct and mediated pathways when the intervention works through an intermediate variable.
candidates.minimal_test: Vary the mediator model and check whether the NDE/NIE sign remains stable.
candidates.why_zh: 干预通过中间变量起作用时，区分直接路径和中介路径。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 改变中介模型，检查 NDE/NIE 的符号是否稳定。

candidates.why: Estimate heterogeneous effects for the subpopulation that receives the alternative action.
candidates.minimal_test: Calibrate CATE predictions against a held-out randomized subset.
candidates.why_zh: 为接受替代动作的子群体估计异质效应。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在留出的随机子集上校准 CATE 预测。

candidates.why: Represent the latent factors needed to answer a counterfactual query.
candidates.minimal_test: Use a synthetic SCM with known counterfactuals and measure recovery error.
candidates.why_zh: 表示回答反事实查询所需的潜因子。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在反事实已知的合成 SCM 上测量恢复误差。

candidates.why: Report how fragile the counterfactual conclusion is to hidden confounding.
candidates.minimal_test: Repeat the conclusion under a range of sensitivity parameters.
candidates.why_zh: 报告反事实结论对隐藏混杂的敏感程度。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在一组敏感性参数下重复结论。

candidates.why: Choose interventions or queries that discriminate between candidate causal structures.
candidates.minimal_test: Randomize tool access in a sandbox and compare task success with and without the tool.
candidates.why_zh: 选择能区分候选因果结构的干预或查询。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在沙盒里随机开关工具权限，比较有无工具时的任务成功率。

candidates.why: Define treatment versions and interference before treating an agent action as a treatment.
candidates.minimal_test: Run the same prompt under two versions and test whether the outcome changes.
candidates.why_zh: 把 Agent 动作当作处理之前，先定义处理版本和干扰。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 用两个版本运行同一提示，检验结局是否变化。

candidates.why: Estimate effect heterogeneity across agent states or user groups.
candidates.minimal_test: Hold out states and check whether the policy improves the targeted subgroup.
candidates.why_zh: 估计效应在 Agent 状态或用户群体间的差异。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 留出部分状态，检查策略是否改善目标子组。

candidates.why: Model the environment as stable mechanisms and test whether the agent transfers across shifts.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare the agent on original and mechanism-shifted environments.
candidates.why_zh: 把环境建模为稳定机制，检验 Agent 能否跨分布偏移迁移。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在原始环境和机制偏移环境上比较 Agent 表现。

candidates.why: Use conditional-independence tests and edge orientation to recover a graph or equivalence class.
candidates.minimal_test: Run PC/FCI on a known DAG and report SHD and orientation precision.
candidates.why_zh: 用条件独立检验和边定向恢复因果图或等价类。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在已知 DAG 上运行 PC/FCI，报告 SHD 和定向精度。

candidates.why: Optimize a score or a differentiable acyclicity constraint over graph structures.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare GES/NOTEARS against a known DAG under equal sample sizes.
candidates.why_zh: 在图结构上优化评分或可微无环约束。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在相同样本量下，把 GES/NOTEARS 与已知 DAG 比较。

candidates.why: Interventional data can orient edges that observational data leaves equivalent.
candidates.minimal_test: Add one intervention and measure how many edges become identifiable.
candidates.why_zh: 干预数据可以定向观测数据无法区分的边。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 加入一次干预，测量有多少边变得可识别。

candidates.why: Use lagged conditional independence or Granger-style tests for time-ordered data.
candidates.minimal_test: Evaluate on a known lagged SCM and report false-edge rate.
candidates.why_zh: 对按时间排列的数据使用滞后条件独立或 Granger 类检验。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在已知滞后 SCM 上评估，报告错误边比例。

candidates.why: Model lag order and nonstationarity before testing causal links.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare PCMCI with and without regime shifts in a synthetic series.
candidates.why_zh: 检验因果关联之前，先建模滞后阶数和非平稳性。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在合成序列上比较有、无机制突变的 PCMCI。

candidates.why: Transport a relationship learned in one period or site to another.
candidates.minimal_test: Leave out the final period and test transport on it.
candidates.why_zh: 把一个时期或站点学到的关系迁移到另一个时期或站点。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 留出最后一个时期，在它上面检验迁移。

candidates.why: Check how much hidden confounding would change the time-series conclusion.
candidates.minimal_test: Report sensitivity bounds across candidate lag orders.
candidates.why_zh: 检查隐藏混杂会在多大程度上改变时间序列结论。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在若干候选滞后阶数下报告敏感性边界。

candidates.why: Learn a latent causal representation with temporal structure and identifiable factors.
candidates.minimal_test: Recover known latent factors from a synthetic temporal SCM.
candidates.why_zh: 学习带时间结构和可识别因子的潜因果表示。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 在合成时序 SCM 上恢复已知潜因子。

candidates.why: State the adjustment set before asking an LLM to answer a causal question from text.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare answers with and without the explicit adjustment set.
candidates.why_zh: 让 LLM 根据文本回答因果问题之前，先写明调整集。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 比较给出和不给出显式调整集时的回答。

candidates.why: Check whether a causal answer transfers across corpora, domains, or prompt versions.
candidates.minimal_test: Hold out a corpus and test the same causal question.
candidates.why_zh: 检查因果回答能否跨语料、领域或提示版本迁移。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 留出一个语料，测试同一个因果问题。

candidates.why: Use text-derived conditional-independence evidence as input to a constraint-based search.
candidates.minimal_test: Compare the graph with and without LLM-derived CI evidence.
candidates.why_zh: 把文本导出的条件独立证据作为约束式搜索的输入。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 比较有、无 LLM 条件独立证据时的图。

candidates.why: Score candidate graphs produced from text and data.
candidates.minimal_test: Measure graph score against a known DAG.
candidates.why_zh: 对文本和数据生成的候选图打分。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 用已知 DAG 测量图评分。

candidates.why: Ask the model to choose the next interventional test when a benchmark allows it.
candidates.minimal_test: Measure regret against a random intervention policy.
candidates.why_zh: 基准允许时，让模型选择下一次干预检验。
candidates.minimal_test_zh: 相对随机干预策略测量 regret。
